name: MonarchTag
title: Tag
summary: A chip people act on: a label that can be removed, selected, or both.
whenToUse: For labels a person adds and removes, and for filters that toggle.
whenNotToUse: For a status that is never acted on, use MonarchBadge. For a choice of one among several, use a Picker.
api: init(_ text: String, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, size: MonarchTagSize = .md, removeLabel: String? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

init(_ text: String, isSelected: Binding<Bool>, systemImage: String? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, size: MonarchTagSize = .md, removeLabel: String? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: isSelected
options.description: Whether the tag is on. Giving it makes the label a button that toggles it.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: An SF Symbol before the text. Decorative.

options.name: tone
options.description: Selects the colours while the tag is not selected.

options.name: size
options.description: sm is 24 points high, md is 28.

options.name: removeLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the remove button, "Remove" and the text.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Runs when the remove button is activated. No remove button without it.

states.name: selected
states.description: Accent fill, border and text, with a check mark before the text.

states.name: removable
states.description: A remove button follows the text.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted fill and disabled text colour, with disabled(_:). The buttons do not respond.

appearance: A capsule with the subtle fill, the border and the strong text colour of its tone; the neutral tone uses the muted background and the default text colour. A selected tag uses the accent subtle fill, accent border and accent strong text in every theme.
platformNotes: The web Tag also has an accent tone, which MonarchTone does not have; a selected tag uses the accent. The web TagGroup (arrow-key movement between tags and focus hand-over after a removal) is not offered: lay tags out yourself. Backspace and Delete do not remove a tag. The selection is always a binding; there is no uncontrolled form. The tag is a capsule here and has 8-point corners on the web. Android covers Tag by theming the Material 3 chips.
accessibility: A selectable tag is a button with the selected trait while it is on, and shows a check mark, so the state does not depend on colour.
The remove button is a separate element named "Remove" and the text of the tag; removeLabel replaces the name.
A selectable or removable tag is at least 44 points high; the visible capsule stays 24 or 28 points and the touch target extends above and below it.
The touch target of the remove button is at least 44 points wide and reaches 12 points back over the end of the label.
A tag with no binding and no remove action is read as its text. The icon is hidden from VoiceOver.
edgeCases: Long text wraps inside the capsule.
On a tag that is both selectable and removable, the last 12 points of the label belong to the remove button.
A plain tag is 24 or 28 points high, so tags of different kinds in one row have different layout heights.

examples.title: Tones
examples.template:
MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: MonarchTokens.Space.space2) {
    MonarchTag({{items.0.label}}, tone: {{items.0.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag({{items.1.label}}, tone: {{items.1.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag({{items.2.label}}, tone: {{items.2.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag({{items.3.label}}, tone: {{items.3.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag({{items.4.label}}, tone: {{items.4.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag({{items.5.label}}, tone: {{items.5.tone|tone}})
}
examples.code:
MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: MonarchTokens.Space.space2) {
    MonarchTag("Neutral", tone: .neutral)
    MonarchTag("Accent", tone: .accent)
    MonarchTag("Info", tone: .info)
    MonarchTag("Success", tone: .success)
    MonarchTag("Warning", tone: .warning)
    MonarchTag("Danger", tone: .danger)
}
